definitions.name: R3D.MOD
definitions.body: 'R3D.MB' BIND 'R3D.MA' BIND R3D.MA R3D.MA R3D.MB DIV FLOOR R3D.MB MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a modulo b (a minus b times floor of a over b)

definitions.name: R3D.DIFFS
definitions.body: 'R3D.DV' BIND R3D.DV 1 DROP R3D.DV -1 DROP SUB
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> Vector one shorter of each element minus the one before it

definitions.name: R3D.STARTS
definitions.body: 'R3D.SV' BIND [ TRUE ] R3D.SV R3D.DIFFS [ 0 EQ NOT ] MAP CONCAT
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> same-length Boolean Vector, TRUE where a run of equal adjacent values starts

definitions.name: R3D.MASK
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector, same-length Boolean Vector -> the elements at the TRUE positions, in order

definitions.name: R3D.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'R3D.PV' BIND R3D.PV -1 DROP R3D.PV 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector one shorter of adjacent pairs [ previous current ]

definitions.name: R3D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'R3D.DN' BIND 1 R3D.DN RANGE [ R3D.DN DIV RATIO 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

definitions.name: R3D.ISPRIME
definitions.note: positive integer -> TRUE when it is prime

definitions.name: R3D.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'R3D.RS' BIND 1 6 RANGE R3D.RS [ 'R3D.RX' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String of at most 12 chars -> the String after repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs

definitions.name: R3D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'R3D.TR' BIND R3D.TR KEYS R3D.TR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the earliest key among ties

definitions.name: R3D.SKUQTY
definitions.body: 'R3D.SO' BIND R3D.SO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP R3D.SO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'R3D.SG' BIND R3D.SG KEYS R3D.SG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders Vector -> Record from each sku to the sum of its qty, skus in order of first appearance
